recent_other_camera_output_links.scope: one latest-past-other-camera output-implied identity link per current common GT-matched detection;20-group horizon fixed from GEO validity; positive opportunity means that GT was matched in another camera within the horizon; no evaluable link on such a query is missing; correction/harm counts require known positive opportunities
recent_other_camera_output_links.limitations: An observable output-link diagnostic, not the internal Hungarian candidate selected or actual model candidate coverage. The latest GT-matched reference can skip unknown/unmatched detections; absent evaluable links without a known positive are not certified correct rejections; ambiguous simultaneous reference labels remain unknown. Counts repeat over different query frames but are linear in detections, not quadratic all-time pairs.

scope: actual complete causal output identity links on common one-to-one IoU>=.5 GT-matched detector outputs; all anchors use strictly previous synchronized groups; raw identities scoped per scene; GT only post-inference
limitations: Pure/mixed/new anchor categories are observational output relations, not actual Hungarian decisions or proof of appearance/pose/candidate-coverage cause. An ID without a past matched-GT anchor can still have earlier unmatched detections; these categories do not prove a new track was born. Unanchored categories remain separate, not automatically correct or wrong. Patch-center count uses exact official518/14 pad mapping; zero coverage does not imply ROIAlign failure. Past unmatched detections are not labeled. No GT used to choose online pairs, schedules or thresholds.
unproven_cause_categories: geometry failure as cause of identity change
